page.overview:
Who is Paladin Took II?

Paladin II Took was a Hobbit of the Shire and the thirty-first Shire-thain. He was the father of the famous hobbit Peregrin Took.

Paladin was the only son of Adalgrim Took and his unnamed wife and the brother of Esmeralda (Took) Brandybuck. Paladin married Eglantine Banks, and had four children: Pearl Took, Pimpernel Took, Pervinca Took, and Peregrin Took.

Paladin succeeded his childless second cousin Ferumbras III Took as Shire-thain in TA 3015.

When Saruman took control of the Shire through Lotho, he resisted and organized a defense against the Chief's men. Paladin Took II died in FO 13, at the age of one-hundred and one.
